title: Cosmic Duality Embrace
description: A surreal painting depicts a black-skinned figure covered in glowing green spirals and golden eyes facing a white horned female figure with empty black eyes. A vibrant blue and orange patterned serpent coils around both, framing a detailed night cityscape with a bridge and full moon visible inside its body.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork showing a black figure with glowing golden eyes and intricate green spiral patterns on their skin facing a pure white female figure with horns and blank black eyes. A large ornate serpent in bright blue and orange with intricate patterns coils around both figures. Inside the serpent's body appears a night city skyline with bridge and glowing moon. Left side features frogs, flowers, and nature elements, right side shows a starry red cosmic space with a small colorful figure standing on the serpent. Mystical atmosphere with dramatic lighting.
